svg.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
svg.title: Mini-map — Desert
svg.desc: One world hex, opened out: a hexagonal field of 61 cells in the terrain's own colour and patterned with its own map mark, each cell the size of a world-map hex, with an encounter panel and a holdings panel either side. This sheet is desert (D): the field is that terrain's printed wash from palette.json, patterned with that terrain's own map mark (dune) on the ink plate - no render, no plate. 9 cells across, 61 cells in all, each 16.7 mm across the flats, which is a world-map hex on the korvane-reach four-sheet preset. Generated by tools/build-minimaps.mjs from data/minimap.json, data/components.json and data/terrain.json - do not edit. 297 x 210 mm at 8 units/mm, 3 mm bleed. The ink plate alone is the black-and-white edition.
